steps.name: Epilogue ~ Where Bondage Once Was (1)
steps.objective: Watch the conversation between [Siam] and a visitor in 「World Between Times」.

lines.text: (A mage gazing into the dark sky senses an unusual presence. Though he cannot see, he turns toward it and steps forward.)
(Siam starts slightly as someone takes his hand. Recognizing the warmth of that small hand, he speaks a name he has missed.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Siam... It's been a long time.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Is it truly you, Miss Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...
(At Iris' reply, Siam drops his staff. As she picks it up and hands it back, the emotions she has been holding in suddenly spill over.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Miss Iris, do not apologize to me or pity me. This was entirely my own choice...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Do not cry. Your tears would bring rain to the hearts of everyone who believes in you... So...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There, there.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There, there. Yes... I'll stop.
(Iris wipes away her tears and gives a small smile.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I remembered what you told me. Your grandmother used to say that to make the tears go away.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam. You remembered?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Do not forget that I am a mage whose excellent memory once let him learn countless spells at once. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But how did you come here? This should have been a place beyond your reach...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: 'He,' who threatened this place for so long, is gone. Many people helped us.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now I understand... Weiss...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Ah, Azrael... It saddens me a little to think I cannot return...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam, Weiss' Azrael may be gone... But your Azrael still exists.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Could that be the explanation?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Living here, where the flow of time and space is distorted, I learned that Etoile has multiple timelines.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But I did not know Azrael had multiple timelines as well.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That is why I could not understand how the hero I knew had chosen to become evil to protect Azrael...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I am sorry. A being from our world brought chaos to yours. Though I did not belong to his world...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As you told me, Siam, don't apologize. You weren't responsible.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Very well...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Then, if the opportunity comes, I would like to do what I can for Etoile as a resident of Azrael. Will you permit it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: No, Miss Iris. I am the one who is grateful. Come visit and keep me company from time to time. Oh, Miss Iris?
(Iris gently pulls Siam by the hand.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll let you feel a new light, Siam.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Follow me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Everyone is waiting for you to return.

steps.name: Epilogue ~ Where Bondage Once Was (2)
steps.objective: Watch the conversation between [Dragon Atkina] and a visitor in 「Burning Wheel」.

lines.text: (Inside the otherwise empty wheel, a vast blue-scaled dragon sits with his eyes closed.)
(Atkina opens his eyes and meets the gaze of a being looking at him with love.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Have you been there?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Yes, I visited briefly. Weiss disturbed so many timelines that I had to check on that place...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: As always, time seems to flow differently there.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It is a place where it must.
(Gaia silently looks into Atkina's eyes.)
(As though understanding her gaze, Atkina quietly lowers his head toward her. Gaia gently strokes his face.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Atkina, I've come to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wanted to stay in this land longer this time...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please, Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You guided and supported me when I could do nothing. I am always grateful to you, Atkina.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And to Iris, the new ruler of this star... And to %s, who stands beside her...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And to Valdrick, Ziskad, Shynic, Io, and Medea, who stood with you...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I cannot meet them now to thank them in person, but I hope to do so properly next time.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will tell them for you. You need not worry. But...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Does Lady Iris know? That you are going to Pneuma?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now that I have returned, Iris will know. But I cannot meet her now. My familiarity with that place may have a harmful effect... I must leave at once...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. It is that sort of place.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please give my regards to the Weaver... to that child in Pneuma, as well.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I will. And Atkina... Thank you...
(Gaia quietly closes her eyes, and a small butterfly flies into the wheel.)
(It circles nearby, then slowly leads Gaia away.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will wait until you return...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even if you awaken in another form, I will recognize you first...
(In the darkness, a lonely voice rises from someone watching the memory of a place.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Gaia...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: You were fortunate this time. To think that child Iris would change fate in such a way.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I said I would reunite you with Seres, didn't I? How cruel of you to prevent me from keeping that promise.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I will watch for a while this time. There are others who wish to see the world you loved disappear.
That is a lengthy conversation with yourself.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Haha. Will you call me Oathbreaker too?
No.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Shortly before you, a creation of the architect who departed for another world fell here. It displeased me, but all is well now.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Come to think of it, you are not a complete being.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Why did you answer my call? You could have ignored it and passed on.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I know you also seek the 'salvation' the sinner desired. I called to confirm it. Everything rests on creation and will as you understand them...
Are you finished?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Yes. There was something I wished to confirm. You may return at once.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ah, the road to the 'salvation' you seek will be far from easy.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: That land still holds many beings that do not belong, besides you. Devils and demons, the goddess' people, sinners who escaped their fate...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: And those who await the night...
Enough.
This is the only time I will meet you. And I hope we do not meet again until everything is over.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Your own story is hardly short, hahaha. Very well. I will send you back.
(When the being speaking with him vanishes, the old man slowly turns his gaze elsewhere in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Merely someone's creation, yet it refuses to show its hand.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Then I shall look forward to the new day... the new night to come.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ah, I nearly forgot.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Emissary of the goddess, watching this: you may open your eyes now.
